spec.kitLine: Activates on a Full Charge attack
spec.assertion: Both skill1 buffs must re-apply >= 40 times over 180 s (RL yields ~75-95 full charges). Fails under the nearest-wrong keyings: passive (1 apply), burstCast (~5-9), fullBurstEnter (~8-10), lastBullet (~15). Full-charge vs shot-fired is not separable on a charge weapon - it.skip'd.

buffApply targetSlug set for the 10.34 crit-damage buff has exactly one member and it is NOT n102 (Supporter 98,367 loses to Attacker 118,027). Fails under {kind:'self'} (proved live by the s1Self counterfactual, which flips the target to n102 and moves the board) and under an allies-scoped encoding (which breaks the teammates-byte-identical inertness check). byFinalAtk vs static ranking is non-discriminable here - it.skip'd.

Emitted stat must be maxAmmoFlat with value 3 and a bounded expiresFrame; removing every ammo-stat effect must change the recipient's total. Fails under maxAmmoPct 3 (a ~3% nudge, wrong stat key) and under a dropped/ignored ammo line (no event at all, and a zero-delta counterfactual).

critDamagePct 10.34, bounded window; stripping it lowers ONLY the top-ATK ally while every teammate stays byte-identical (crit damage feeds no gauge/rotation path). Fails under coreDamagePct/generic mis-keying (no matching event), a wrong magnitude (no matching event), or an allies-scoped target (teammates move).

chargeDamagePct 25.84 on exactly the same single ally skill1 picks, bounded expiresFrame, more than one application; stripping it lowers only that ally. Fails under chargeDamageMultPct (a true multiplier, wrong bucket semantics), under a permanent/passive encoding (single t=0 apply and/or unbounded expiry), and under a self/allies target. The trigger period itself is NOT asserted - no activation clause and no skill cooldown are in the input domain.

The 25.86 ATK wave must reach every slug in the team map, n102 included; narrowing the target to alliesTopAtk count 1 must lower the team sum, and stripping the burst ATK effect must lower every ally's total. Fails under allies+excludeSelf (n102 unmoved) and under any narrowed target.

The emitted stat must be atkPct carrying the raw percentage 25.86 - a casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct encoding re-emits a FLAT ATK number, so no 25.86 event would exist and the non-vacuity assertion goes red. Boundedness is asserted structurally, and stretching the window 10 -> 60 sec must raise the team sum (20 s burst CD plus stage-1 sharing keeps uptime under 100%), which fails under a permanent encoding.

fixtures: controlComp('n102', true) only - liter (B1) / crown (B2) / n102 in the carry slot as camera focus / helm as the fixed B3 (SR + Water). The fixed B3 is required: n102 is Burst I and a stage-1 unit alone makes zero Full Bursts. Because n102 SHARES burst stage 1 with liter, her own burst casting is asserted explicitly (ATK wave count > 0) instead of assumed - with ~20 s cooldowns against a ~13-15 s rotation cycle the two B1 units alternate, so she should cast several times; a zero-cast result would be a fixture block, not an override defect. This same comp also guarantees the highest-final-ATK ally is an Attacker-class SR (a charge weapon), which is what makes the Charge Damage line observable at all. 8 hoisted 180 s runs total: base plus 7 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (strip crit damage / strip ammo / strip charge damage / strip burst ATK / narrow burst target / stretch burst duration / self-target skill1). Counterfactual helpers read a slot as either Block[] or {blocks: Block[]} so a patch can never silently no-op.
gaps: skill2 trigger identity + cadence - the kit prose carries no activation clause and the packet supplies no skill cooldown, so any period is invented (FLAG). it.skip'd; only stat, magnitude, single-target scope, boundedness and re-firing are asserted.
highest FINAL ATK (live effectiveAtk) vs static ATK ranking - both resolve to the same Attacker in this comp, so byFinalAtk is unobservable. Needs a fixture where a buff flips the ranking.
Full Charge attack vs any shot fired - the base weapon is a charge weapon (chargeFrames 90), so every modeled shot is a full charge and the two triggers are observationally identical.
The exact 10 sec skill1 window - re-firing every ~1.5-2 s holds it at ~100% uptime, so the duration value cannot be read off totals; only a bounded expiresFrame is asserted.
